$Comment: What a Christmas Present holds when another player gives it to you: the better table, so giving a
present away always beats opening your own (Christmas_Present_Gift). The giver points the present
at you and uses it (Item/Interactions/Christmas/Christmas_Present_Give.json), which pays this table
to you, not to them, and tells you who it came from.
The roll always pays a few more Christmas Coins than an opened present, through the Currency reward
kind. Pool is one draw from the bag below, weighted against each other: a better treat (more candy
canes, two cookies, a cocoa), a bigger handful of snowballs, or now and then a Winter Bauble or one of
the game's Christmas Packets. Every item goes where your pickup settings send it, with the game's own
pickup notice, and whatever your bag cannot take drops at your feet.
Text names this table wherever a reward paying it is shown and gives its hover a line. A companion
mod adds its own rolls with a file of its own that names this table in ContributesTo.
Name: Christmas_Present_Given
